rules.review_retention: Retain every valid source review row, including rows with identical content or source IDs.
rules.missing_optional_text: Convert empty or whitespace-only optional fields to SQL NULL via empty CSV values.
rules.review_body: Preserve nonempty original text exactly; blank text becomes SQL NULL.
rules.date: Parse source date and write ISO YYYY-MM-DD.
rules.invalid_required_data: Reject rows with invalid ASIN, required ID/title/date/rating/stars/helpful count, malformed JSON, or orphan ASIN.
